english:
Midday Psalm 115 [116:15]: Precious is. Proverbs:
Wisdom 5:16: "But the righteous" to verse 18: "from enemies." Prophet Jeremiah, Lamentations
3:22: "The mercies of the Lord" to verse 56: "my voice." Apostle 2 Timothy 3:10:
"But you followed" to verse 15: "in Christ Jesus." Alleluia: in the tone [of the day]. Gospel Luke
12:32: "Do not fear" to verse 40: "the Son."

Tuesday. Of the Holy Witness Astvatsatur [Adeodatus].
Patristic [hymn] of the Martyrs. Midday Psalm
115 [116:15]: Precious is. Proverbs 10:1: "A wise son"
to verse 6: "untimely." Prophet
Isaiah 56:3: "Let not the foreigner say" to verse 8: "of the Gentiles, says the Lord."
Apostle 2 Timothy 2:3: "Share in suffering"
to verse 10: "with glory." Alleluia: of the martyrs
in the tone [of the day]. Gospel Matthew 10:16:
"Behold, I" to verse 22: "he shall be saved."

And before the fast of the Epiphany, reckon four days,
excluding Wednesday, Friday, and
Sunday, according to the indication of the Calendar, on which you shall celebrate
the major feasts of witnesses prior to the Birth of our Lord
Jesus Christ. But in the evening after the Common
Hour, perform the Pre-festive service [Nakhatonak], saying the complete hymn of the day.
After the Petition: "Christ God."
Litany: "By the Holy Ascetics." Prayer: "Who hast chosen."

First Feast of the Saints: David the Prophet
and James the Apostle. Tone 3 [gah]:
"He was found victorious" with its companion hymns. For these
four feasts as well, "King forever" (Tagavor havityan) [is]: "Today
the ranks of angels," say [this]. Magnificat [Metsatsustse]: "Morning
of Peace." Hymn of the Youth [Mankunk] and Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [dah]:
"Bless the Lord." Midday Introit: "Lord,
Who didst establish." Hymn: "Mercy" (Voghormya)
here. Psalm 131 [132]: "Remember, O Lord, David."
Book of 2 Samuel 5:1: "And there came all"
to verse 10: "was with him." Death of David: 1
Kings 2:1: "And the days drew near" to verse
11: "thirty and three." Prophet Ezekiel
33:23: "Thus says the Lord" to verse 27: "from their oppressors." Catholic Epistle of James
1:1: "James, of God" to verse 12: "to those who love Him." Alleluia: "The Lord swore." Gospel
Matthew 22:41: "And while gathered"
to verse 46: "him, nor anything." Eucharistic
acclamation: "Almighty."

Second Feast: Of Saint Stephen the Proto-
witness and first martyr. Tone 2 [gah]:
"Champion" with its companion hymns. Midday Introit:
"Today rejoices" and "Chosen from the womb." Hymn Tone 8 [tah]: "Today rejoices."
Psalm 5: "Lord, as with a shield." Acts 6:8:
"Stephen, a man" to verse 8:2: "over him." Alleluia: "Strengthened by the Holy Spirit."
Gospel John 12:24: "Truly, truly
I say" to verse 26: "him my Father [will honor]."

Third Feast: Of the Holy Apostles Peter
and Paul. Tone 3 [gah]: "Today rejoices the
Church of God," with its companion hymns. Midday
Introit: "Apostles." Hymn Tone 3 [gah]:
"Yokes of faith." Psalm 18 [19]: "Through all
the earth." Proverbs Wisdom 9:13: "For
who is a man" to verse 10:2: "to hold all."
Prophet Isaiah 28:16: "Therefore"
to verse 19: "to hear, O afflicted ones." Catholic [Epistle]
2 Peter 1:12: "Wherefore I will prepare"
to verse 19: "in your hearts." Apostle 2 Timothy
4:1: "This testimony" to verse 8: "his appearing." Alleluia: "You shall appoint." Gospel
John 21:15: "And when they had dined"
to verse 22: "come follow me."

Fourth Feast: Of the Holy Sons of Thunder,
James the Apostle and John the Evangelist.
Tone 4 [gakh]: "Who is in essence,"
with its companion hymns. Magnificat [Metsatsustse]: "The Mother of God, a cloud
of light." Hymn of the Youth [Mankunk] and Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [tah]: strophe: "Who in the unshadowed." After the Youth [Mankunk]: Psalm
sung in the tone of the transition of death: "Return, O my soul, to
your rest, for the Lord has called you."
Response: "I loved, because the Lord will hear the voice of
my prayer; because He inclined His ear
unto me, and I in my days called upon
Him." Again: "Return, O my soul." And
then they shall begin to read: "The blessed one was with the brethren." After that: "Creator-like" according to
the proper of the day. Petition: "Christ
God." Litany: "By the Holy Ascetics."
Prayer: "Who hast chosen." Midday Introit:
"Today awesome." Hymn Tone 8 [tah]:
"Sons of thunder." Psalm 95 [96]: "Proclaim the good news."
Proverbs Wisdom 7:21: "The artisan of all"
to verse 24: "of purity." Prophet Jeremiah 16:16: "Behold..."
